title: Balances Owed at Other Network Desks Held From Insurance Claim Repairs Refunds
content:
**Memo clause.** Charges the customer still owes at other network desks are held from an overpayment refund on an Insurance Claim Repairs repair order: the customer's estimate-stage charges left after payments and waivers when there are any; otherwise the customer's warranty charges left after payments and waivers; otherwise nothing.

- **Estimate-stage charges** are the customer's charges under Repair Estimates & Appointments, less the payments and the waivers recorded against them there.
- **Warranty charges** are the customer's charges under Workmanship Warranties, less the payments and the waivers recorded against them there.

The amount held is taken off the excess on the repair order before the refund is limited to the payment it returns; the refund never falls below zero.

## Order of reading

| Estimate-stage charges left | Warranty charges left | Held |
|---|---|---|
| above zero | any | the estimate-stage charges left |
| none | above zero | the warranty charges left |
| none | none | nothing |

Only one of the two is held: where estimate-stage charges are left, the warranty balance is not added to them.

## Hypothetical balances

- Estimate-stage charges USD 150.00, paid USD 50.00, waived USD 25.00: USD 75.00 left, so USD 75.00 held, whatever is owed on warranty charges.
- Estimate-stage charges fully paid; warranty charges USD 95.00 with nothing paid or waived: USD 95.00 held.
- Both fully settled: nothing held.
